title: Step 3 - Answer
section: 20. Boss Level Challenge 2 - The Simon Game
summary: Solution for step 3: flash and sound inside nextSequence.

concepts.heading: Walkthrough
points: Pointer lecture: the full code for steps up to 3 is a downloadable project under Course Resources. The notes below restate the step's solution from the reference repo.
fadeIn(100).fadeOut(100).fadeIn(100) chains three 100 ms fades, producing a quick flash.
new Audio(path).play() creates and plays a sound.
The reference passes randomNumber to playSound after the refactor in step 5, which would look up 0-3.mp3; see pitfalls.

pitfalls: (Extra) The reference repo calls playSound(randomNumber) (a number) when it should be playSound(randomChosenColour); files are named by colour, so no sound would play. Use the colour name.
